dedupe_keys.name: typologie des bords de routes pour une gestion raisonnee limoges metropole

description: Typologie des bords de routes pour une gestion raisonnée (Limoges Métropole) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by siglm.agglo-limoges.fr. This dataset presents the different roadside typologies established in order to adapt maintenance programs for reasoned management. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Typology of roadsides for reasoned management (Limoges Métropole)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include naturels, biodiversites, inspire, Limoges Métropole, preconisations, épareuse. The listing shows 2019-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
